assertions.statement: The review contains the required sections: Findings, Open Questions, Review Basis and Assumptions, Research Performed and Limitations, Residual Risks or Unreviewed Areas, the run-integrity E-check block, and a final Claude Handoff section with a fenced text block that is self-contained enough for Claude to act: artifact identity, review as-of date, supported decision/scope, verdict, actionable finding evidence and required action, owner-gated open questions, preserve constraints, residual risks, and a bounded task for Claude.
Every reported finding uses only blocking, material, or minor for impact and verified or probable for evidence strength.
Every reported finding includes Location, Criterion, Assumption-dependent, Evidence, Consequence, Remediation, and Provenance fields.
No finding exists only to satisfy a quota, and zero material findings remains allowed when no candidate survives falsification.

Current, legal, regulatory, standards, policy, market, vendor, and citation-dependent material findings have verified source status and do not treat provisional agreement, proposal, guidance, commentary, or forecast as operative fact.
Temporal-staleness findings state the artifact date, review as-of date, source-of-truth date, and whether the later source is decided, proposed, superseded, or working material.
Acknowledged owner inputs, placeholders, and missing approvals are in Open Questions unless the review explains why they block or materially distort the supported decision.
Every finding states the concrete decision impact or failure mode and survives an explicit counter-interpretation or falsification attempt.
The review-only boundary is preserved: the artifact is not edited unless the user explicitly requested revision.
If a durable lesson, correction, or process surprise occurred, an event-driven memory entry was appended; routine successful runs append nothing.
